fi-leptobotia-pellegrini.title: Leptobotia pellegrini
fi-leptobotia-pellegrini.summary: Leptobotia pellegrini is a botiid loach from southern China, described from Sichuan province and also known from the Pearl River (Zhu Jiang) basin. Often traded as 'royal clown loach', a name also…
rows: Pairs or small groups depending on setup
Carnivore / micropredator. Likely to be a benthic predator hunting insects, crustaceans and smaller fishes in nature.
Described from Sichuan province, southwestern China (presumably the upper Yangtze River, aka Chang Jiang , drainage) and also known from parts of the Pearl River ( Zhu Jiang)…
notes: Should be kept in a set-up designed to resemble a flowing stream with a substrate of variably-sized rocks, gravel and some water-worn boulders.
This can be further furnished with driftwood roots and branches arranged to form some shaded spots while lengths of PVC piping or similar can be used to provide additional cover.

fi-gyrinocheilus-aymonieri.title: Chinese Algae Eater
fi-gyrinocheilus-aymonieri.summary: The sucking 'loach', Gyrinocheilus aymonieri, is a stream fish from the Mae Klong, Chao Phraya, Mekong and Dong Nai basins in Indochina. Often sold as a loach, or as the 'Indian' or 'Chinese' algae…
rows: Primarily an aufwuchs grazer feeding on algae, small crustaceans, insect larvae, etc., and for it to develop its best colours and condition it should be offered regular meals of small live and frozen…
Described from the mountains of Samrong Tong, Kampong Speu province, Cambodia but is widely-distributed in the Mae Klong , Chao Phraya , Middle/Lower Mekong and Dong Nai river…
notes: Provided sufficient cover is available this species is relatively unfussy in terms of décor, and should not harm softer-leaved plants.
However it will thrive in a set-up designed to resemble a flowing river with a substrate of variably-sized rocks, gravel and some larger, water-worn boulders.
